name: UI：产业带种草链路-环节结构验证(含图文上传节点)
description: 验证产业带种草链路的环节结构，包含新增的图文上传环节，以及各环节策略配置

steps.description: 打开产业带种草链路详情

steps.expression: (() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const expectedStages = ['入参图刷标签', '首图生成', '标题文案生成', '图片审核']; const foundStages = expectedStages.filter(s => t.includes(s)); const stageArea = document.querySelector('[class*=linkNode], [class*=stageCard], [class*=StageCard]'); const stageText = stageArea ? stageArea.textContent : ''; return { expectedCount: expectedStages.length, foundCount: foundStages.length, foundStages, hasImageTextUploadInStageArea: stageText.includes('图文上传'), allStagesPresent: foundStages.length === expectedStages.length }; })()

(() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=stageCard], [class*=StageCard], [class*=stage-card], [class*=linkNode]')); if (cards.length === 0) { const allDivs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div')); const stageDivs = allDivs.filter(d => { const t = (d.textContent || ''); return (t.includes('入参图刷标签') || t.includes('首图生成') || t.includes('图文上传')) && d.children.length > 0 && d.children.length < 30; }); return { cardCount: stageDivs.length, source: 'fallback-div' }; } return { cardCount: cards.length, source: 'css-selector' }; })()

steps.label: industry-seeding-stages
steps.description: 产业带种草链路环节结构

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；产业带种草链路已创建
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 产业带种草链路=种草20205基础上新增'图文上传'环节; 预期6个环节: 入参图刷标签/首图生成/首图审核/套图生成/标题文案生成/套图审核+图文上传
riskPoints: 图文上传环节是否已添加到链路
环节顺序是否正确(图文上传应在最后)
